subject: Draft case study: NexisBio — accuracy check & quote approval
messages:
From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwood.ai>
To: Dr. Emily Chan <emily.chan@nexisbio.com>
Cc: Robert Tucker <rtucker@nexisbio.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 18 Nov 2026 09:15:00 -0800
Subject: Draft case study: NexisBio — accuracy check & quote approval

Hi Emily —

Thanks again for the time last week. Attached is the first draft of the NexisBio case study (nexisbio_case_draft_v1.docx) and a short metrics CSV we pulled from the pilot (nexisbio_metrics_table.csv). We tried to keep the public-facing wording light on internal implementation details but included a brief technical sidebar for your review.

Could you please:
- Confirm the three highlighted results (30% inference cost reduction, 2.4x throughput improvement, and 96.7% uptime over the trial) are acceptable to publish as-is or provide corrected figures.
- Review the quote attributed to Dr. Chan on page 2 — we used the line you shared in the demo wrap-up but shortened it. If you'd like different wording, we'll incorporate it.
- Flag any regulatory or compliance language that needs to be altered for NexisBio approval.

We aim to publish a one-page case study and a longer webpage narrative next Wednesday (Nov 24). If you can get redlines back by Friday EOD (Nov 20) that would give us time to iterate with legal.

Attachments: nexisbio_case_draft_v1.docx (draft), nexisbio_metrics_table.csv (raw numbers)

Thanks — really appreciate your help with this.

Best,
Sofia Ivanova
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
sofia.ivanova@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0187

From: Dr. Emily Chan <emily.chan@nexisbio.com>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwood.ai>
Cc: Robert Tucker <rtucker@nexisbio.com>
Date: Thu, 19 Nov 2026 10:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Draft case study: NexisBio — accuracy check & quote approval

Thanks, Sofia — and thanks for sending the clean draft. We reviewed internally and a few quick notes before we send this to Legal: 

1) Metrics: The throughput number should be 2.1x (not 2.4x). The 2.4x was peak during a short benchmark; the sustained average was 2.1x across our production traces.
2) Cost reduction: the 30% is correct for tokenized inference cost after batching/quantization. Please add the parenthetical "(post-batching/quantization)" after the percentage so it's clear.
3) Uptime: 96.7% is what our monitoring reported in the first two weeks, but overall uptime for the 60-day pilot was 99.2%. Use 99.2% in the main stat and mention the 96.7% as "early pilot" detail in the notes.
4) Quote: I'm comfortable with the sentiment, but could we restore the slightly longer version I gave during the wrap-up? I prefer: "Redwood dramatically reduced our inference costs while making model responses far more predictable — the engineering lift was minimal and results arrived fast."

Attached is a redline (I exported comments from the doc). Also note: Legal asked us to remove any reference to specific cloud provider names; I didn't see any in your draft but flagging just in case.

Happy to hop on a 20-min call if you want us to walk through the redlines.

Emily
Dr. Emily Chan
Head of ML Engineering, NexisBio
emily.chan@nexisbio.com | +1 617-555-3301

From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwood.ai>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 19 Nov 2026 11:10:00 -0800
Subject: Fwd: Draft case study: NexisBio — accuracy check & quote approval

Folks — Emily sent redlines and the corrected metrics (attached). Key asks: change throughput to 2.1x (sustained), show 99.2% uptime as the main stat, append the parenthetical to the cost reduction, and replace the quote with the slightly longer sentence. Legal wants no cloud vendor names.

Can Marcus confirm the wording on the throughput line (2.1x) vs any internal phrasing we should use? Aditya, can you check the metrics CSV and confirm the 30% cost reduction phrasing with the parenthetical will still be accurate if we highlight post-batching/quantization? Monica — if we turn this into a 1-pager + web narrative, I'll need a quick design for the metrics callout; can you slot this for Friday?

Also: Emily requested final approval by Friday EOD (Nov 20). If legal pushes back, they may request a short co-approved statement rather than the full quote.

Thanks —
Sofia

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 19 Nov 2026 12:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Draft case study: NexisBio — accuracy check & quote approval

Sofia — quick checks: 
- Confirmed: Sustained throughput for their production traces = 2.1x (we should say "2.1x sustained throughput" in the stat line to avoid confusion).
- Cost reduction: Aditya, if you can confirm the 30% (post-batching/quantization) is the median token-level cost reduction across their sample windows, we can keep that phrasing. If it's a mean, we should say "~30%".
- Uptime: Use 99.2% for the pilot headline; add "(96.7% early pilot metric)" in the notes.

I'll provide a one-sentence technical sidebar explaining batching/quantization impact (non-sensitive). Recommend we avoid any provider names — use "our managed runtime" instead.

Marcus
Principal Solutions Architect | Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwood.ai

From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwood.ai>
To: Dr. Emily Chan <emily.chan@nexisbio.com>
Cc: Robert Tucker <rtucker@nexisbio.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 14:02:00 -0800
Subject: Updated draft & quote for NexisBio — approval request

Emily — thanks again for the detailed notes. We've incorporated your changes:
- Headline stat updated to: "99.2% uptime during the 60-day pilot" (we included early pilot detail: "96.7% early pilot window").
- Throughput stat updated to: "2.1x sustained throughput".
- Cost stat updated to: "~30% inference cost reduction (post-batching/quantization)" to reflect median behavior.
- Quote replaced with your suggested sentence verbatim.
- Removed all cloud provider references and replaced with "our managed runtime" where relevant.

Attached is the revised one-page case study (nexisbio_case_draft_v2.docx) and a short tech sidebar. If this works for NexisBio, please reply with a line like "Approved for publication" and we will route to Legal for the final signoff and then schedule publishing next week.

If Legal requests co-approved language instead of the quote, we can offer a shorter joint statement — let me know.

Appreciate the partnership on this.

Best,
Sofia Ivanova
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
sofia.ivanova@redwood.ai
